items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) {c : ℝ} (p : Polynomial R),
  0 ≤ c → ∀ [NonnegHomClass F R ℝ], 0 ≤ Polynomial.gaussNorm v c p
items.informal_description: For a polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, if $ c \geq 0 $ and $ v $ is a non-negative valuation (i.e., $ v(a) \geq 0 $ for all $ a \in R $), then the Gauss norm $ \|p\|_v^c $ satisfies $ 0 \leq \|p\|_v^c $. The Gauss norm is defined as the supremum of $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i $ over all coefficients $ a_i $ of $ p $, with $ \|p\|_v^c = 0 $ when $ p $ is the zero polynomial.
The Mahler measure of any polynomial $ p $ is non-negative, i.e., $ \text{MahlerMeasure}(p) \geq 0 $.

items.type: {R : Type u_1} → {F : Type u_2} → [inst : Semiring R] → [FunLike F R ℝ] → F → ℝ → Polynomial R → ℝ
items.informal_description: The Gauss norm of a polynomial $ p $ is defined as the supremum of $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i $ over all exponents $ i $ in the support of $ p $, where $ a_i $ is the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ p $. If $ p $ is the zero polynomial (with empty support), the Gauss norm is defined to be $ 0 $. Here, $ v $ denotes a valuation and $ c $ is a real number parameter.

items.informal_name: Coefficient List Length Equals Zero or Natural Degree Plus One
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R] (P : Polynomial R),
  P.coeffList.length = if P = 0 then 0 else P.natDegree + 1
items.informal_description: For a polynomial $ P $ over a semiring $ R $ with decidable equality, the length of the coefficient list of $ P $ is 0 if $ P $ is the zero polynomial, and $ \operatorname{natDegree}(P) + 1 $ otherwise.

items.informal_name: Length of Coefficient List Equals Successor of Degree
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (P : Polynomial R), P.coeffList.length = P.degree.succ
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $P$ over a semiring $R$, the length of the coefficient list of $P$, ordered from the highest degree term down to the constant term, is equal to the successor of the degree of $P$ in $\mathbb{N} \cup \{-\infty\}$. Specifically, if $P$ has degree $d$, then the coefficient list has $d + 1$ elements; for the zero polynomial (degree $-\infty$), the coefficient list is empty and $\text{succ}(-\infty) = 0$.

items.informal_name: Cardinality-based absolute value on polynomials over a finite field
items.type: {Fq : Type u_1} → [inst : Field Fq] → [Fintype Fq] → AbsoluteValue (Polynomial Fq) ℤ
items.informal_description: The function assigns to each polynomial $ p $ over a finite field $ \mathbb{F}_q $ the value $ 0 $ if $ p = 0 $, and $ |\mathbb{F}_q|^{\deg(p)} $ (as an integer) otherwise, where $ \deg(p) $ denotes the natural degree of $ p $. This satisfies the absolute value properties: non-negativity, multiplicativity ($ |pq| = |p||q| $), and the triangle inequality ($ |p+q| \leq |p| + |q| $).
